name: 1Set Silicon 3Liter Urinal for Men, Women, Urine Collection Bag, Reusable Silicone Urine Collector Portable Wearable Female, Male Urinary Drainage Bag
description:
1Set Silicon 3Liter Urinal for Men, Women, Urine Collection Bag, Reusable Silicone Urine Collector Portable Wearable Female, Male Urinary Drainage Bag 
Product efficacy:- Reduce the occurrence of bedsores in bedridden patients, avoid urinary tract infections caused by catheterization, relieve the pain of urine immersion, avoid frequent wetting of bedding, and reduce the burden on parients and nursing staff. 
Storage:- Store in a cool, dry and ventilated place. 
Specific feature* Washable and recyclable * Soft and comfortable * Skin friendly and breathable and Suitable for all seasons. 
Note:- 1) Close contact between the penis, urethral opening, and the opening or the silicone catheter bag to prevent urine exposure. 2) The sukicibe catheter bag is tightly connected to the plastic catheter. 3) The urine collection bag should be placed in any position so that the plastic catheter is lower than the silicone catheter position and avoid twisting the catheter and plastic catheter. 4) Long term use, keep the contact area between the urine collection bag and skin dry and hygienic.
